text.p: Close of play scores on the opening day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Wednesday:
At Cheltenham: Derbyshire 120 (K.Barnett 58; M.Smith 6-47). Gloucestershire 306-4 (S.Young 156 not out, M.Alleyne 63 not out, T.Hancock 54).
At Canterbury: Kent 356-7 (M.Ealham 96 not out, P.Strang 82, T.Ward 51) v Leicestershire.
At Old Trafford: Lancashire 380-5 (N.Fairbrother 132, J.Crawley 112) v Sussex.
At Northampton: Northamptonshire 354-9 (D.Roberts 117; P.Grayson 4-53) v Essex.
At Trent Bridge: Warwickshire 328-9 (D.Hemp 70, D.Ostler 65; P.Franks 4-81) v Nottinghamshire.
At Guildford: Surrey 457-9 (A.Stewart 98, G.Thorpe 84, A.Hollioake 75, M.Butcher 69, C.Lewis 66 not out) v Hampshire.
At Scarborough: Durham 152 (J.Lewis 50; D.Gough 4-37). Yorkshire 137-2 (A.McGrath 57 not out).
